title: fix(lint)!: os build and the page save door refuse a page component props CEL slot over the platform parse bounds (#25002)
body:
Closes #25002
Clause-②: no (narrowing: a page component props CEL slot over the platform parse bounds is refused at `os build` and the page door; it ships now under the amended 「甲」, #6015 `6303865025`)

## What changes

`page-predicate-over-budget` (`validatePagePredicateBounds`, `packages/lint/src/validate-page-predicate-bounds.ts`) reports at `error` instead of `warning`. In the same edit, its entry in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` moves from the `advisory` tier to the `gating` tier. A page carrying a CEL slot inside a component's `properties` bag whose source overruns `DEFAULT_LIMITS` (`maxAstNodes` 256, `maxDepth`, `maxListElements`) now fails `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint`. An active write of that page, or the promotion of its draft, is refused at the page save door. This is the refusal half of #24953, re-timed to 18.x by triage (6305866852) under the amended 「甲」 (#6015 `6303865025`).

- The message drops "A future major release refuses it." The docblock's "Why a warning" section becomes "Why an error" and cites the amended ruling. The registry entry's comment says why the tier is `gating`.
- `PagePredicateBoundsFinding.severity` is typed `'error'`.
- No runtime or door code moves: the door already splits findings by severity, `error` to the refusal and the rest to `advisories`.

## The door's code, measured

The card says `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`. The page save door actually answers **`422 INVALID_METADATA`**, the author-time refusal envelope every runtime-gate refusal uses. The new pin asserts `{ code: 'INVALID_METADATA', status: 422 }`, the same as the #23388 and #24491 page blocks next to it. The changeset says `INVALID_METADATA`.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-page-predicate-bounds.test.ts`: the warning assertions are now error assertions. The finding is `severity: 'error'`, and each of `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` reports it as the page's only error. The page door's `errors` channel carries the build's finding verbatim, with nothing on `advisories`. The tier is `gating`. The message no longer contains "future major". The within-bounds CONTROL is unchanged and green.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`: a new block, "runtime authoring gate on PAGE writes — a props-bag CEL slot over the parse bounds (#25002)", runs through the REAL `saveMetaItem` / `publishMetaItem`. It is inserted after the #24491 page block, not at the end of the file, which keeps it textually apart from open PR #25052's append. It pins:
  - (a) the card's ~390-node (78-term) `page:tabs` item `visibleWhen` answers `{ code: 'INVALID_METADATA', status: 422 }`, with one `page-predicate-over-budget` issue at `pages[0].regions[0].components[0].properties.items[1].visibleWhen` naming "`maxAstNodes` budget (platform limit 256)", and no active row is stored;
  - (a) the draft → active promotion is refused the same way;
  - (b) the door's finding equals `os build`'s, key by key;
  - (c) CONTROL: a within-bounds tab predicate saves, and the row lands.
- `runtime-gate.page-visibility-predicate-writes.test.ts`: one comment now says "refusal" instead of "warning". The dispatch-order pin is unchanged.

Evidence (run on head `53ae2b07d2`, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build` and `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/metadata-protocol^...' build`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-page-predicate-bounds.test.ts src/runtime-gate.page-visibility-predicate-writes.test.ts src/authoring-rule-wiring.test.ts` → `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 59 passed (59)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` → `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 180 passed (180)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`) → exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (the whole package) → `Test Files 153 passed (153)`, `Tests 7056 passed (7056)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` → exit 0 (in the same `&&` chain, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`).

### Ablation (one-shot, nothing left in the tree)

Committed first, then mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor `severity: 'error',` above `rule: PAGE_PREDICATE_OVER_BUDGET,`, hit x1 -> x0, blob `e4a15923c57d` -> `51d908070c3a`) to the pre-change severity, spelled `['warning', 'ablation25002'][0] as 'error'` so the marker survives the bundle. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build`, then `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/lint ablation25002` → marker present in 4 built files.

- Mutant, lint: `validate-page-predicate-bounds.test.ts` → `Tests 5 failed | 13 passed (18)` (the error finding, `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`, the door's errors channel).
- Mutant, door: `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts -t '#25002'` → `Tests 3 failed | 1 passed | 176 skipped` ((a) refusal, (a) draft promotion, (b) parity fail; (c) the within-bounds control stays green, as it must).
- Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, `git diff HEAD` empty, hash `e4a15923c57d` equals the HEAD blob; rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` → marker absent from all 20 built files, tree clean. Restored run: lint file `18 passed (18)`, door file `180 passed (180)`.

## Producers, measured before crossing

0 in-repo producers carry such a slot, so this PR fixes none:

- **Page modules:** every `*.page.ts` and `pages/*.ts` module under `examples/` and `packages/` (30 files, 65 page values), loaded with tsx and judged by the built `validatePagePredicateBounds`, gives 0 findings.
- **Composed stacks:** the `app-crm`, `app-multi-package` and `app-todo` stacks also give 0. The `app-showcase` config did not load here, because an unbuilt `@objectstack/connector-mcp` was missing; its pages are covered by the page-module pass.
- **Literal scan:** every tracked `.ts/.tsx/.mts/.js/.mjs/.json/.yaml` file under `examples/`, `packages/` (dogfood and the package pages included), `skills/`, `apps/` and `content/docs/` was scanned (9,919 files). Each string literal or `+`-chain of 120 or more characters (13,840) was judged by `validateExpression`'s bounds verdict, and 0 are `cel-too-large`.
- **HotCRM:** the same literal scan over `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` at `c8a7a70` (611 files) finds 0.
- **Positive controls:** a planted 78-term predicate is found by both instruments.
- **Residual:** a predicate assembled at run time (template substitution, `.join`) is outside the literal scan. The page-module pass covers it for the in-repo pages.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 66 commands at `53ae2b07d2`, and all 66 were run. 63 exit 0, including `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` (it reads the `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:test-source-alias`. Three are NOT MEASURED, each exiting 3 on its own prerequisite and not on a finding:

- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: needs a whole-workspace `dist/`.
- `check:lean-entry-closure`: needs a built `@objectstack/objectql`.
- `check:type-check-debt`: its closure build hit the shared verify lock's queue budget.

CI runs all three. `dispatch-gates --ran` with every exit code recorded: `66 derived, 63 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

## Acceptance notes

- The pending changeset `.changeset/24953-page-predicate-bounds-warning.md` (from #24999, not yet released) still says "A future major release refuses it." If both ship in one release, the two CHANGELOG entries for `@objectstack/lint` disagree. This PR's changeset says it supersedes the warning-only behaviour. The other file is outside this claim's file surface, so it is not edited here. The seat can amend that one sentence in a follow-up if wanted.
- The card's `VALIDATION_ERROR` is not what the door answers. See "The door's code, measured" above.
- No generated docs reference this rule, and the CLI's rule count (`Running author-time rules (50)`) does not move. Nothing was regenerated.

## Release

`@objectstack/lint` `minor`, BREAKING (FROM a warning with the page saved, TO an error with the page refused). The one-line fix: shrink the predicate, or precompute it into a formula or roll-up field. ADR-0087: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, following the shape of bb4f5cc005. `content/docs/releases/` is untouched.
